sections.introduction:
Poothikasavam is medicated preparation which is mild alcoholic in nature. As the name suggests it contains pootikaranj (Holoptelea integrifolia ), its main ingredient. It is an important formulation for treatment of hemorrhoids, varicosity and malabsorption syndrome. It also promotes strength to bones and joints. 
 Classical Indication 
 According to classics, Poothikasavam is explained by Acharya Vaghbat for increasing digestion and piles growths. Among all three dosha it helps in pacifying pitta and rakat. Some of the classical indication of Poothikasavm are given as following- 

 Improves Digestive Fire (Jatharagni vridhi) 
 Digestion (Vata anulomana) 
 Haemorrhoids (Arshas) 
 Spleen disorders (Splenomegaly) 
 Tumors growth (Gulma) 
 Abdominal disorders (Udar roga)
sections.ingredients:
The list of all decoction, powdered drugs used for making poothikasavam are given as following- 
 Kwath Dravya (Decoction Drug) 
 Poothika/ Chirbilva (Holoptelea integrifolia) – (2 Tula) 24 grams 
 Prakshep Dravya (Powdered drug) 
 Trikatu – (8 pal) 384 grams 

 Sunthi (Zingiber officinale ) 
 Marich ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Pipali ( Piper longum ) 

 Madhur Dravya (Sweetening Agent) 
 Guda (Jaggery) – (80 pal) 3.5 kg 
 Benefits Of Ingredients 

 Poothika- It is useful in treating inflammatory conditions. It cures nausea, indigestion, gastritis, intestinal problems and piles like abdominal disorders. It also acts as a blood purifier and can be given in diabetes patients. 
 Shunthi – It improves the overall metabolism of the body and corrects digestion like loss of appetite, flatulence, tastelessness, etc. It relieves all types of pain like headache, abdominal pain, backache and menstrual pain also because it balances vitiated vata dosha in the body. 
 Marich- It is helpful in treating chronic respiratory disorders such as asthma, cough, and bronchitis. It induces bowel movements and helps in cleaning the intestines. It removes excessive fat deposition such as dyslipidemia or obesity. 
 Pipali- it has anti-inflammatory, antioxidant and analgesic properties. It works on stress and relaxes our mind. As it works on kapha dosha so it helps in curing cough, asthma and other respiratory disorders. 
 Jaggery- It helps in boosting digestion and eliminates acidity complaints. It helps to clear intestinal worms and activates digestive enzymes in our body. It is rich in vitamins and minerals and is a rich source of iron, potassium. 

 Method Of Preparation 
 Following are the steps for preparation of Poothikasavam- 

 Collect all the kwath dravyas (decoction drugs) mentioned above and wash them properly. 
 Then add all decoction drugs to 12 liters of water for boiling. 
 Keep boiling the decoction till it remains on fourth. 
 Then add sweetening agent guda/ jaggery to the solution 
 At the end add all prakshep/ powdered drugs to the decoction obtained. 
 Stir the solution properly and strain it in a clean vessel. 
 Then cover the vessel tightly with the lid and cover it with any cloth. 
 Leave it undisturbed for at least one month for fermentation. 
 After one month asava is prepared, then again stir and strain the solution. 
 Store the asava in a clean glass airtight container, away from direct sunlight. 
 It will be ready to use after an interval of one year.
